title: Declared monotone constraints were not enforced by the original champion configuration
evidence: LightGBM 4.7, constraint method 'advanced': grid test showed predictions moving the wrong way for 20% of loans on LTV (worst raw-score step -0.042) and 14% on DTI; the 'basic' and 'intermediate' methods gave 0%.
recommendation: Champion re-fit with the exact 'intermediate' constraint method; post-fix grid test in this report.

title: Champion train-to-OOT AUC decay exceeds tolerance
recommendation: Part in-sample optimism (train-tune gap), part regime drift (tune-OOT). Tighten regularisation; monitor AUC quarterly; re-estimate on rolling window.

title: Weak rank-ordering in segment fico_band=<660
recommendation: Investigate segment-specific drivers; consider segment overlay.

title: Calibration-in-the-large breach on stress (model under-predicts)
recommendation: Model has no macro inputs and never saw a downturn; PD level is point-in-time for the training regime only. Do not use for capital/pricing without a macro overlay or recalibration; add crisis-vintage stress to monitoring.

title: Calibration-in-the-large breach on covid_exhibit (model over-predicts)
recommendation: Observed defaults were suppressed by pandemic forbearance, deferral and disaster relief, which the hardship-guarded target removes from the numerator; 2019 is not a valid calibration test. Treat forbearance-heavy periods as a data-relevance trigger and suspend calibration monitoring on affected cohorts.

title: Score PSI red on vintage 2018
recommendation: Population shift vs development sample; confirm inputs (CSI) and recalibrate if persistent.

title: Original interest rate is confounded with calendar time
evidence: orig_rate has IV 0.41 in the scorecard and top-3 permutation importance; average rates move ~1pp across training vintages, so the feature partly encodes vintage rather than borrower risk pricing.
recommendation: Replace with spread to the month's PMMS 30-year average (FRED MORTGAGE30US) at redevelopment; test in ablation.

title: Target definition depends on servicer-reported hardship flags
evidence: Primary target excludes 90+ DPD months in or within 3 months after a forbearance plan (Borrower Assistance Plan = F) or a disaster-flagged month. Without the guard, 2018-2019 36-month default rates are 4.6-4.9% vs 0.7-1.0% with it; 70-77% of unguarded events cure within a year, and 58% of the 2019 events remaining after the forbearance guard alone carried the disaster flag.
recommendation: Keep both definitions in monitoring; treat forbearance-heavy periods as a data-relevance trigger per SR 26-2 §V.

title: Crisis vintages are outside the development population (score PSI > 1.5)
recommendation: Expected by design of the stress backtest; documents that the model would be extrapolating in a 2006-style book.

title: Development sample excludes HARP loans and is the 50k-loan public sample
evidence: HARP = 11-35% of 2009-2014 originations, defaults 2-4x non-HARP, DTI undisclosed. Train has 1,359 defaults across 270,948 loans after exclusion.
recommendation: State scope in intended use; use Standard dataset for segment-level recalibration if the model is adopted.
